local.headline: Tigers fall to Temple in final seconds; weekend weather looks better
body: Temple beat the Memphis Tigers 35-31 on Friday, with the game decided in the final seconds, according to University of Memphis Athletics. An ABC News headline said the Owls came back from 17 points down in the fourth quarter of the regular-season finale.

The Daily Memphian reported that Memphis leaders are looking at bringing the Essence Festival to the city. On the weather front, Action News 5 said Friday that rain and snow were due to move out that night, leaving better conditions for the weekend.

sources.title: Rain and snow forecast to clear

state.headline: State data show gaps in who uses private school vouchers
body: Black and Latino families are underrepresented in Tennessee's private school voucher program, according to state Education Department data in a report carried by the Chattanooga Times Free Press. It said 34,999 students are using the $7,530 vouchers this year, while 15% of 41,244 approved applicants declined one. Low-income families were also less likely to use vouchers once approved.

In Nashville, a moratorium on new data center proposals expires Tuesday, the Chattanooga Times Free Press also reported. A dispute over a project proposed near the Nashville Zoo is due before the Board of Zoning Appeals on Dec. 3.

sources.title: Nashville Banner report on voucher program data
Nashville data center moratorium nears its end

federal.headline: Thanksgiving storm leaves hundreds of thousands without power
body: More than 500,000 customers in the Midwest and Northeast were still without power Friday afternoon after the Thanksgiving storm, CBS News reported, citing an outage tracking website. The peak topped 800,000 on Thursday night. PBS NewsHour also reported that hundreds of thousands on the East Coast lacked power. New York's Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed to Saturday, according to ABC News.

On trade, many Republicans say they are open to reconsidering some of President Trump's tariffs, according to an Associated Press report carried by PBS NewsHour. It said Democrats, who are set to take control of Congress, may find partners among them.

sources.title: East Coast outages as rain eases
Marching bands adjust to parade delay

international.headline: US says it disabled a ship trying to pass its blockade of Iran
body: U.S. Central Command said Friday that American forces disabled a commercial ship that tried to get past the blockade of Iranian ports, CBS News and The Hill reported. The command said an aircraft struck the vessel's stern Thursday after repeated warnings, and the crew was not harmed. CBS News also reported that President Trump said victory over Iran will come "whenever I want it."

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged the U.S. to pressure Russia's Vladimir Putin and called Trump's description of Putin as a friend strange, according to PBS NewsHour. Separately, Mexico filed a formal complaint with the U.S. over a Drug Enforcement Administration tip line, which President Claudia Sheinbaum called interference, CBS News and ABC News reported.

sources.title: Iran war updates and blockade action
